## Summary

Describe the change and the motivation.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / cleanup
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (if behaviour changed)
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] README.md and README.it.md kept in sync (for user-facing changes)
- [ ] No secrets, hostnames or personal paths added

Anything reviewers should know.
